spans.s: त्र a common term for the krt affixes ष्ट्रन् and इत्र (
-186) in case the vowel इ of इत्र is look- ed upon as equivalent to an aug- ment, as also for the unadi affix ष्ट्रन् and the tad. affixes त्र and त्रल् (
); the tad, affix त्र is added in the sense of समूह or collection to the word गॊ, e.g. गोत्रा; cf. Kas. on

त्रा tad. affix त्रा in the sense of some- thing donated, as also to the words देव, मनुष्य, पुरुष, पुरु and मर्त्य end- ing in the accusative or the loca- tive case; e. g. व्राह्मणत्रा करोति, देवत्रा वसतिः cf. Kas. on
,56. ’There is avagraha before the tad. affix त्रा. देवत्रेति देवSत्रा्; cf. V.Pr.
त्रल् tad. affix termed Vibhakti added to pronouns excepting द्वि and others, and to the words बहु and किम् when they end with the loc. case termination: e.g. कुत्र, तत्र, बहुत्र etc.; cf. Kas. on
